features.description: Chinese natural-language query compiler extracts topic, region, time range, schedule and delivery intent with confidence and warnings.
CEC Bid public-source adapter performs real search, detail cleaning and attachment extraction.
CCGP public-source adapter crawls recent official notices and extracts structured detail fields.
Qianlima authenticated-source adapter consumes a user-authorized free-member session and detects expired authentication.
Evidence-first normalization, relevance filtering, cross-site duplicate clustering and project lifecycle grouping are implemented.
Evidence-gated summarization works offline and supports an optional OpenAI-compatible model with safe fallback.
DOCX generator produces compliant filenames and reports with required fields, coverage disclosure and evidence.
Persistent subscriptions, scheduler and exactly-once incremental delivery ledger work for immediate, daily, weekly and one-off jobs.
Local, Feishu webhook and Feishu Open Platform delivery channels are implemented with diagnostic failures.
FastAPI REST API and polished Chinese Web UI complete the query-to-report workflow.
CLI supports running queries, serving the app, checking sources and importing an authorized login session.
Automated tests cover intent examples, source parsers, deduplication, incremental delivery, DOCX output and API smoke flows.
Design document, operation manual, registration copy, supplemental deck/PDF, demo script and defense materials are delivered.
End-to-end online run generates multiple real reports and passes an independent judge-style evaluation.
Cross-platform Python bootstrap, Docker image, Compose web/worker deployment and Windows/macOS/Linux CI are provided.
Users can inspect source operations and fully manage subscription rules, state, delivery policy and execution logs in the Web UI.
Standard SMTP delivery sends DOCX attachments and no-change receipts with SSL or STARTTLS without blocking the async worker.

Project-level opportunity workspace only accepts persisted tender evidence, deduplicates by project, persists follow-up state, refreshes lifecycle snapshots and provides a browser-managed board and evidence timeline.
Intent compiler v2 recognizes common Chinese cities, expanded time and schedule expressions, exclusions and explicit event types while preserving full lifecycle for generic tender queries.
Browser runtime configuration center persists allowlisted AI and delivery settings, encrypts secrets at rest, masks all secret reads and provides guarded real connection tests.
DingTalk, WeCom and generic webhook channels join Feishu and SMTP with standard payloads, bounded timeouts, sanitized errors and explicit real-send tests.
Every OpenAPI operation and the standalone API, configuration, delivery and user guides provide detailed Chinese usage, parameters, returns, side effects, errors and examples.

Hybrid intent engine keeps a deterministic rules-v2 baseline, invokes an optional LLM only for low-confidence, missing or conflicting fields, accepts strict JSON proposals and merges only locally validated field decisions with an auditable trace.

Zero-result runs expose scanned-to-candidate-to-kept funnels, per-filter exclusion counts, source coverage gaps and bounded safe relaxation suggestions in both the Web UI and generated diagnostic DOCX reports.

Cross-platform lifecycle controls provide serve, status, authenticated loopback stop and restart behavior while preserving subscriptions, schedules, delivery ledgers, opportunities and encrypted runtime configuration.

A reproducible beginner-handbook builder produces a 43-page Chinese DOCX with an updated TOC, real UI screenshots, semantic headings and numbering, exact table geometry, image alt text, stop/restart guidance, backup procedures and troubleshooting decision trees.
An auditable retrieval planner combines deterministic expansions with optional strict-JSON LLM terms, source priorities and bounded query variants while rejecting unsafe or unverifiable proposals.
The pipeline performs a bounded second retrieval round when measurable coverage gaps remain, avoids duplicate URL fetches and exposes round-by-round diagnostics and gap reasons.

Hard date, region, event-type and exclusion filters remain deterministic while borderline topic candidates can undergo evidence-bound batch LLM relevance review with auditable decisions and safe fallback.
At least three additional real tender sources provide fixture-tested parsing, honest capability metadata, independent failure isolation and online smoke evidence.
A graphical source center manages capability visibility and user-driven local browser authorization sessions without exposing credentials or bypassing access controls.
A reproducible retrieval benchmark compares the legacy single-query baseline with the multi-round system across fixed Chinese tender queries and verifies evidence URLs and non-regression.
Region-aware official adapters route city-specific queries to high-value local procurement portals, retrieve public detail evidence and skip irrelevant regions without false failure claims.

A unified graphical source authorization manager opens a visible local browser for user-controlled login, encrypts scoped cookies, exposes start/complete/test/clear lifecycle state and never stores credentials or solves access challenges.
The Web search experience visualizes the real AI plan, each retrieval round, gap trigger, hard filters, semantic review and deduplicated outcome while exposing all retrieval controls graphically.

An evidence-grounded AI intelligence brief converts real retrieved notices into buyer needs, opportunity priorities, risks, recommended actions and cited evidence with strict JSON validation, caching and deterministic fallback.
Source operations retain health history, latency, yield and coverage diagnostics so users can distinguish healthy, partial, authorized, skipped and failing channels over time.

Chinese API and beginner documentation explains every new retrieval, authorization and AI intelligence field, endpoint, side effect, safety boundary and troubleshooting step with copyable cross-platform commands.
A Guangdong provincial government-procurement adapter performs public full-text search, regional routing, detail hydration and attachment preservation with honest online diagnostics.
Users manage a persistent company capability profile graphically, including offerings, strengths, target regions, disqualifiers and decision preferences without editing configuration files.
Every retained opportunity receives an evidence-bound profile-fit assessment and bid, watch or skip recommendation through strict-JSON LLM reasoning with deterministic fallback and visible citations.

An evidence-grounded conversational copilot answers follow-up questions only from a persisted run evidence set, rejects unknown citations and survives service restarts without storing raw model responses.

Relevant, irrelevant, watch and contacted feedback is persisted, visibly editable and materially influences later fit ranking through bounded transparent personalization that users can inspect or reset.
A buyer intelligence radar aggregates only locally captured evidence into organization activity, lifecycle and topic views and can create auditable buyer-monitor subscriptions from the Web UI.
